summary: Trust-boundary review of the hygiene machinery. The untrack step uses git rm --cached with the -- separator and paths drawn only from the fixed CRUFT globs (no pathspec or argument injection) and clean_git_env throughout. The secret scan reports 'line N: <label>' and never echoes the secret VALUE, so the report is not itself a data-exposure vector. forge mode abandon PRESERVES _require_harness_marker (it cannot bypass the repo-kind or budget gate), refuses without an open window and a --reason, ledgers an 'abandoned' event, and only unlinks the window-state file, never evidence. sanitise never deletes task-scoped .factory evidence: stale state is reported, cleared only via the human-gated intake --discard-active; --check is read-only and CI-safe. The harness-health cadence change adds no new secret surface (same job, now event-triggered).
